description: This file implements the TokenCache class, which manages caching of token entries with expiration handling. It provides methods to add, retrieve, clear cache entries, and check for imminent expiration, using synchronization primitives for thread safety.

classes.name: TokenCache
classes.description: A class that handles caching of token entries with expiration logic, supporting thread-safe put, get, clear, and expiration check operations.

methods.name: void Put(const std::string & key,const TokenEntry & entry)
methods.description: Stores a TokenEntry in the cache associated with a key, with thread safety.

methods.name: bool Get(const std::string & key,std::string & outJson) const
methods.description: Retrieves the token JSON string if valid and not nearing expiration, otherwise returns false.

methods.name: void Clear()
methods.description: Clears all entries from the cache.

methods.name: bool IsExpiringSoon(uint64_t nowEpochSec,uint64_t expiryEpochSec) const
methods.description: Checks whether a token that expires at expiryEpochSec is nearing expiration relative to nowEpochSec.
